derivation: probably from the same as G4010 (Πέργαμος);
def: a tower; Perga, a place in Asia Minor

occurrences.text: Now when Paul and his company loosed from Paphos, they came to Perga in Pamphylia: and John departing from them returned to Jerusalem.
But when they departed from Perga, they came to Antioch in Pisidia, and went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and sat down.
And when they had preached the word in Perga, they went down into Attalia:
